name: etaHEN
author: LightningMods and contributors
firmwareListNote: etaHEN release notes only mention firmware that a release adds, fixes or tests. No release publishes a complete supported-firmware list, so a firmware that a release does not mention is treated as unknown for that release, never as supported.
loading: etaHEN is a payload that a separate PS5 exploit and ELF loader load on the console. VantaFlow never performs or automates that step.
